catalog.name: WhatsApp
catalog.description: Let the agent read and reply in WhatsApp chats and groups — paired as a linked device on a number you dedicate to it.
catalog.hint: This is an UNOFFICIAL connection — it links to WhatsApp the way WhatsApp Web does, which is against WhatsApp's terms of service, and numbers do get banned. Use a DEDICATED number (a prepaid SIM or eSIM), never your personal one: the agent acts as that number. No Meta account, no webhook, no public URL — pairing takes a minute.

steps: Get WhatsApp running on a dedicated number (any spare phone, prepaid SIM or eSIM).
Enter that phone number here, with country code (e.g. +49151…).
This card will show a pairing code. On the phone: WhatsApp → `Settings` → `Linked devices` → `Link a device` → `Link with phone number instead`, and type the code.
The card turns active. Message the number (or add it to a group) and create an automation with WhatsApp as its source.
